# ScribeCat 0.25.15

### Document and PDF viewer
- On phones, keep the viewer focused on paging, zoom and close.
- Set the document and PDF zoom range to 100–300% on desktop and mobile.

### PowerPoint preview
- Render slides using the actual PPTX slide dimensions and object geometry instead of a fixed 1600×900 reconstruction.
- Render text runs, common shapes/fills/lines, images, grouping transforms and theme colors so the slide more closely matches the original presentation surface.
- Preserve the native aspect ratio of each slide during fit and zoom.

### Split view
- Keep Word and PowerPoint connected to the existing "open beside this note" split flow used by PDF.
- Keep the split action visible on desktop and unavailable on phones.
